name: millennium-fashion-editorial
image_purpose: Y2K fashion lookbook and campaign image

prompt.project_info: Create a high-gloss early-2000s fashion editorial with two adult models, newspaper-print styling, and a clean studio backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: Two adult fictional female fashion models with original identities in bold editorial poses: one kneeling with long platinum-pink straight hair, the other standing or seated closely behind with a short black wavy bob. Both wear coordinated editorial two-piece fashion sets with newspaper-inspired prints, statement accessories, small generic shoulder bags, and printed over-the-knee boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body dual-model shot, 50mm static studio angle, one model kneeling in the foreground and the second behind with a hand at the hip, white seamless backdrop, soft floor shadows, strong fashion-magazine composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Flat front-lit studio light with soft diffused fill and subtle contour shadows; desaturated whites, chrome, denim blue, muted skin tones, and graphic print accents with light vintage grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Still photography, 50mm editorial lens look, full-body framing, early-2000s campaign grain, high-detail textile and print rendering, natural anatomy, no fixed brand marks or readable text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Full-body dual-shot early-2000s high-fashion editorial photograph of two adult fictional female models with original identities. One kneels in the foreground with long platinum-pink straight hair; the other stands or sits closely behind with a short black wavy bob. Both wear coordinated editorial two-piece fashion sets with newspaper-inspired graphic prints, statement accessories, small generic shoulder bags, and printed over-the-knee boots. Clean white seamless studio backdrop, soft floor shadow, static 50mm angle, flat front-lit studio light with diffused fill, high-gloss bold styling, light vintage fashion grain, desaturated whites, chrome, denim blue, muted skin tones, and graphic print accents.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, exact facial identity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, fetish framing, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed hands, unreadable text, recognizable designer logo, watermark, signature, plastic skin, over-saturated, HDR look

assets.name: millennium-fashion-editorial.jpg
assets.usage: Reference the two-model pose, pink and black hair contrast, printed boot styling, white studio, and early-2000s visual language while replacing designer marks and personal identities.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the dual-model hierarchy, hair contrast, print-led outfit concept, boots, lighting, and Y2K consistency. Use original adult fictional identities, generic replaceable accessories and prints, and avoid fixed logos or rendered typography.

changes: Replaced designer references and provocative framing with generic adult fictional models and editorial two-piece styling while preserving the Y2K concept.
